remarks: Charming bungalow offering 2 bedrooms and 1.5 baths freshly painted with hardwood floors throughout the main living areas. Bright and inviting layout with an open flow between living room, dining room, and kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, updated cabinetry, and granite countertops.  Upstairs includes a spacious primary bedroom and an additional bedroom with good closet space and an updated full bath.
